translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: 1 CORINTO
book.title: Dos Unnon Sulat ni Pablo Atag to mgo Toho CORINTO

content: Purisu mgo suwod, ikula a nikiyu iling taddot kod-ikuu ku ki Disas Krays.
Dos Ollog nod Puungan to mgo Ba-ay riyot Kodlolivuung tod Pompomakoy
Na id doong ku sikiyu, su inaayun kow'd sampot koddi woy id tuman dow iddos id nonaw ku koniyu.
Piru duwon pa id kopi-i ku nod koovottan dow. Si Disas Krays kos timbang uu to langun no mama. Dos mgo mama mandad kos timbang uu taddot sawa ran, woy dos Monama kos timbang uu ni Disas Krays.
De-en diyot kodlolivuung dow, iddos mama nod dasaa o od ponudtuu taddot id poposaddoo kandin to Monama, otik id totambun sikandin to uu rin, na id po-ilawan din si Disas Krays no timbang uu rin.

Piru iddos ba-ay nod dasaa o od ponudtuu taddot id poposaddoo kandin to Monama, otik waa tambun to uu rin, na id po-ilawan din iddos kandin no sawa no timbang uu rin. Od poko-ilow idda no iling to ba-ay nid popogung.

Otik diid kopiyan iddos ba-ay nod totambun to uu rin, moppiya pa kod tompoddan din kos bowvuu rin iling to bowvuut mama. Piru pomon tod poko-ilow me-en iddos kodpotampod to bowvuu o kodpopogung, na ko-ilangan en nod totambun sikandin to uu rin.

Dos unayan no konna od totambun to uu iddos mama diyot timpu to kodsimba, su id bovallan to Monama kos mama iling kandin amoy id pokita iddos kotungud woy bantug din. Piru iddos ba-ay, id bovallan to Monama atag to kodposivantug to mama.
Su riyot tigkonayan to id bovallan to Monama kos minuvu, waa bovalli kos mama pomon diyot ba-ay, ko konna, iddos ba-ay kos id bovallan pomon diyot mama.
Woy waa bovalli kos mama atag to ba-ay, ko konna, id bovallan kos ba-ay atag to mama.
Idda en kos unayan no iddos ba-ay, ko-ilangan no od totambun to uu rin, su amoy ahad iddos mgo ponolihan, od pokosaddoo no id po-iraom dos ba-ay to kodponguu to sawa rin.

Piru poomdomma row no pomon to nosokkad kowd diyon tod Longaggon, konnod poko-oseng dos ba-ay no dii rin od ko-ilonganon iddos mama. Woy konna mandad od poko-oseng dos mama no dii rin od ko-ilonganon iddos ba-ay.
Su ahad diyot tigkonayan, id bovallan dos ba-ay pomon diyot mama, woy ko-ungkay, id tobbow kos mama ukit to ba-ay. Piru iddos langun, id pomon en to Monama.
Na poomdomma row ini. Ollog bo no iddos ba-ay, od dasaa riyot Monama to kodlolivuung dow no waa sikandin id totambun to uu rin? Konna en.
Nooyami tad no pomon poron, moobbava en kos bowvuut mama, oyyos od poko-ilow man idda otik mowwet iling to bowvuut ba-ay.
Piru iddos ba-ay no mowwet kos bowvuu, bantug din idda. Id boggayan sikandin to mowwet no bowvuu no id tambun to uu rin.

Otik duwon od kopiyan nod apuu moka-atag ka-ay, ini ra kos od ko-oseng ku kandin. Ini en kos botasanon no id ikuu roy no iddos mgo ba-ay, od totambun to uu ran, woy ini en kos id ikuu taddot id ponlolivuung nod pompomakoy to Monama.
Dos Kodsampot to Kopotayan tod Longaggon
Na, duwon pa od osengon ku koniyu, woy ka-ay en pantok no dii ku sikiyu od doongon. Oyya su riyot kodlolivuung dow to kodsimba, konna moppiya kos undahon, ko konna, nokodora-at baling.
Su unnot langun, nokorinog a no ipat timpu nod lolivuung kow to kodsimba, od pokodba-adba-ad kow, woy imman tod pokopongimbonnaa a no duwon dad kovonnaan ka-ay.
Moppiya rad en ayu no od pokodba-adba-ad kow, amoy od kosorollan ko ondoy koniyu kos mooggot nod pompomakoy no id kahaa-i to Monama.
Diyot kodlolivuung dow amoy'd sampot to kopotayan tod Longaggon, moriyu vos to ginawa row iddos koru-anon tadda, su konna man iddos kopotayan din kos diyot poomdom dow.
No-oseng ku ini, su idda kun so ipat sokkad koniyu, od unno-unna nod ka-an no od ottu-ottu taddot tannow rin. De-en duwon duma nid gutasan, woy duwon mandad duma no nohubug.

Ooy koniyu! Waa vo baoy row nod kannan woy'd inomman dow? Id poddisokkan dow moho to koru-anon iddos id lolivuung nod pompomakoy to Monama, woy id po-ilawan dow pe-en iddos duma no worowora. Ondan kos od osengon ku koniyu? Od doongon ku vo sikiyu taddot id puungan dow? Konna en!
Su id nonaw tod Longaggon koddi inis id nonaw kud koniyu. Na si Disas Krays, iddot bulli to id boligya sikandin ni Judas, mid angoy sikandin to paan,
woy id posolomatan din idda riyot Monama. Nopongnga, id toppiktoppik din iddos paan woy kahi rin to, “Ini en kos lawa ku no id boggoy ku atag koniyu. Puungi row ini atag to kodsampot koddi.”

Na nopongnga ran mid ka-an, ungketen dad en mandad kos id puungan din, mid angoy sikandin to kupa woy kahi rin to, “Inis kupa, ini en kos lammin kodpotonduwoy to Monama no id posivonnalan ukit to longossa ku. Ipat timpu nod inom kow ka-ay, puungi row ini to kodsampot koddi.”
Su ipat timpu nod ka-an kow ka-ay't paan woy od inom kow ka-ay't kupa, id ponudtuu row iddos moka-atag to kopotayan tod Longaggon taman to kodlivod din.

Purisu iddos ahad ondoy nod ka-an to paan woy od inom to kupa tod Longaggon no waa kod-anong-anong to ollog no dontulon tadda, nokosaa iddon minuvu, su id poddisokkan din to koru-anon iddos lawa woy longossa tod Longaggon.
De-en ko-ilangan no iddos ipat sokkad, od poomdommon din pa unna ko ollog bo sikandin no od lonug nod ka-an to paan woy od inom to kupa riyot kodsampot to kopotayan tod Longaggon.
Su otid ka-an sikandin to paan woy'd inom to kupa no waa rin oonongnga iddos kohulugan woy koru-anon to lawa tod Longaggon, na iling to id buyu rin kos silut to Monama riyot kandin no ko-ugolingun.
Idda en kos unayan no mo-uraa koniyu kos moomet woy'd pongkovohokan woy dos duma, id poomatoy.
Piru kod poomdommon ta pa unna ko ondan kos nopuungan ta, konna ki od silutan to Monama.
Piru kod pipitan ki tod Longaggon ukit to kodposuppit keta, po-ukit din ini nod potullid keta, su amoy konna ki od silutan duma to mgo minuvu no konnod pompomakoy.
Purisu mgo suwod, diyot kodlolivuung dow nod ka-an amoy'd sampot to kopotayan tod Longaggon, yo kow'd unno-unna.

Otik duwon sokkad koniyu nod gutasan, ko-ilangan no unna pa sikandin od ka-an diyot baoy rin, amoy konnod undag diyot kodsilut to Monama iddos kodlolivuung dow. Na, moka-atag taddot duma pon pomandu ku, ini kud to kod-unduwon ku.
